# Welcome to the MasterRunners Page.

MasterRunners is a free-to-play multiplayer hand based movement game surrounding a variety of entertaining gamemodes, cosmetics, obstacles, etc.

With over **10+ gamemodes** and an **active player count of 100,000+**, we guarantee this game is worth your time. We have lots to offer, so what are you waiting for!?

# What you can do:
- Play Gamemodes with players across the **WORLD**. MasterRunners can be played worldwide and with our **advanced multiplayer system**, you can enjoy multiplayer & have a very fun time. For the gamemodes, we build special gamemodes that have never been used in others games making us stand out and more fun.
![{"height":1440,"type":"image","width":2560}](https://scontent-sea1-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/86624299_1750476142452666_8570864821809744346_n.png?_nc_cat=107&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=acuXcH7GLEYQ7kNvgFW0R0j&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-sea1-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYDIaPJ2ZRm78QG5x48cC-zKVNtC7t5m9kR4LBJ-PlFauA&oe=675826ED)
- Chill with friends and have a **great time.** With areas such as the "Main Hub", you can relax and have a calming time with buddies as you talk to your hearts desire.
![{"height":1440,"type":"image","width":2560}](https://scontent-sea1-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/38982492_509486201534965_7333984808768808414_n.png?_nc_cat=101&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=7xKg6TAo_ZMQ7kNvgGev4Sf&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-sea1-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYCEPNfPi2EVgBRd6pXtuwRDPP7EkVvqY0LOsUs1Esx-pQ&oe=67581127)
- Shop for new cosmetics at Gregson's Shop with the free in-game currency... Energy! Using energy, you can get all kinds of cosmetics of any type just with one click. This is how you can customize your character!
![{"height":1440,"type":"image","width":2560}](https://scontent-sea1-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/38982613_1216230169384631_6163698231671476667_n.png?_nc_cat=111&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=Z6G39FSGQYkQ7kNvgGBnNzX&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-sea1-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYDSXV6BiLBapk6WjrsGD6YhGrUUE7nNJ_QNjV7VGigIdw&oe=67580975)

- **Survive Monsters..**
![{"height":1440,"type":"image","width":2560}](https://scontent-sea1-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/38974658_770419331698632_3320560763268773557_n.png?_nc_cat=107&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=qryWwnK_ttAQ7kNvgH4STvz&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-sea1-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYBR1sj73WB-JS9-IsUsvFEK2qrbMDbeoEB94loosknY3g&oe=67581767)

And more. 

There is lots to do in MasterRunners, so check it out **TODAY!**
